decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham fits the firm's strategic push into organic self-service lines and is a staple item with steady demand.
Organic Kasseler is a close extension of the core range that supports the organic expansion, though it is a smaller niche than ham.
Organic pepper salami uses the firm's maturation expertise and fits the organic growth direction.
The exotic teriyaki aspik is a niche counter specialty with higher delisting risk, but it is still kept to differentiate the deli counter.
Fennel salami is a flavour variant with moderate risk of rotation, yet it had its own presentation page, which suggests the firm prioritised it.
A classic liver pâté with veal is a mainstream product close to the core range with dependable demand.
